outcomes.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

nodes.question: Can the small square DVD case near the center of the source image be identified as the same object in the edited image, and what is its color there?
nodes.criteria: Complete only if the same source DVD is visibly identifiable in the edited image and is white. Partial if that same DVD is identifiable and visibly changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same DVD is identifiable and remains black with no requested color change. Unknown if the DVD cannot be reliably matched across images or its color/change cannot be established; do not count other white discs as the target.
nodes.binding: Target: the small square DVD case near the center of the source image, with a rectangular outline and visible cover artwork. Compare that same object in the edited image; do not bind to either newly visible circular disc unless visual evidence establishes it is the same source object.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
